headline: Skylight smart calendars up to $110 off for back-to-school
summary: Manage family schedules with shared calendars, to-do lists, and AI-powered event creation. Deals end August 9th.
details: The start of the school year can be hectic, but Skylight's shared smart calendars are designed to help families stay organized. From August 2nd to August 9th, Skylight is offering discounts of up to $110 on its smart calendar devices.

The sale includes the 15-inch Skylight Calendar 2 for $279.99 ($20 off) and the 27-inch Skylight Calendar Max for $509.99 ($110 off). For those looking for a more budget-friendly option, the 10-inch Skylight Calendar is available for $149.99 ($20 off) with a subscription to the $79 per year Plus plan, which includes one free month.

Each Skylight Calendar allows household members to sync events from Google, Outlook, Apple, Cozi, or Yahoo calendars, with personalized color-coded profiles. Users can also create and share lists for groceries and chores, accessible via the calendar or a companion mobile app. The devices also feature built-in weather forecasts.

Subscribing to the optional $79 per year Plus Plan unlocks additional features, including AI that automatically converts emails, photos, flyers, and spreadsheets into calendar entries. This plan also offers meal planning tools, chore assignment and reward systems, and a digital photo frame mode.
